context: Kenji teaches Ren about data processing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: レン君、データ処理、覚えよう。
lines.en: Ren-kun, let's work on data processing.
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Lean slightly forward. Voice carries genuine investment in his learning. Light encouragement on the first syllable, then settle into patient mentor-space.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet eagerness. Sit up a little. Eyes on Kenji, attentive. Small catch in the voice—genuinely grateful to be trusted with this. Not rehearsed, just present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Start with the fundamentals. Those matter most.
lines.style: Teacher's rhythm: deliberate but not slow. Slight tap of conviction on 「基本」. Warm authority—not lecturing down, drawing him into the structure. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quick, decisive. Pen moves already, or the gesture of preparing to write. Small note of determination underneath—showing readiness. Breath steady, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Open, genuine permission. Slight lean back—creating safety through ease. Warmth in the second half. No rush. The kind of assurance that lands because it's real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Voice softens on 「一緒に」. Not a performance—a genuine statement of partnership. Small exhale of relief underneath, like this matters to him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Good. One step at a time.
lines.style: Close of a moment. Gentle nod in the voice. Warmth and closure together. Slight emphasis on the steadiness of pace—reassurance that rushing isn't required.
